items.title: Adobe修補Magento零時差漏洞StyleSmuggler
items.summary: 本週Adobe發布9月例行更新，然而在此之前，該公司緊急修補已遭利用的電商平臺漏洞StyleSmuggler。

items.title: OpenAI宣稱其AI系統解出了七大千禧年數學難題之一
items.summary: OpenAI周二（9/8）宣布，尚未公開的內部AI模型解出千禧年數學難題「Navier–Stokes Existence and Smoothness」（納維-斯托克斯存在性與光滑性問題），但旋即遭控涉及學術倫理爭議。

items.title: 資安業者揭露逾9,300個外洩AWS金鑰仍可用，其中數百個具備企業帳號完整控制權限
items.summary: 資安公司Truffle Security近日發布報告，指出研究人員追蹤與驗證2022年8月至2026年8月間公開洩漏的AWS存取金鑰後，發現超過9,300個至今仍有效，其中還有數百個金鑰擁有企業AWS帳號完整管理權限。研究人員從Git儲存庫、Git歷史紀錄、Hugging Face資料集、Docker映像檔、套件註冊庫及CI日誌等公開來源，找到64,024個AWS金鑰，對應50,654個AWS帳號。

items.title: 銀行迎戰虛擬資產新業務，資安業者共組「穩定幣暨虛擬資產安全聯盟」，協助打造自主可控數位金融安全
items.summary: 隨著全球穩定幣與虛擬資產監管浪潮興起，臺灣《虛擬資產服務法》今年6月三讀通過、7月正式公布，虛擬資產監管制度逐步成形，銀行等金融機構要如何安全接軌虛擬資產業務，也帶動新的資安需求。9月8日，台灣資訊安全協會宣布成立「穩定幣暨虛擬資產安全聯盟」，首波集結中華資安國際、博士旺創新、凱特納科技與普鴻資訊4家業者，從數位金融安全基礎建設所需的不同關鍵能力切入，希望整合臺灣產業能量，逐步打造具國際競爭力的數位金融產業合作模式。

items.title: HPE修補ArubaOS-CX網路作業系統34個資安漏洞，包含可導致遠端程式碼執行的重大漏洞
items.summary: HPE於9月2日發布資安公告，修補ArubaOS-CX網路作業系統（AOS-CX）34個漏洞。

items.title: SAP發布9月例行更新，修補4個重大漏洞
items.summary: 9月8日SAP發布本月例行更新（Security Patch Day），修補19個資安弱點，並更新一則資安公告的內容。從危險程度來看，重大等級與高風險各有4個，中度風險有10個，低風險漏洞1個。根據CVSS嚴重程度評分，最危險的是記憶體中斷漏洞CVE-2026-44756，CVSS評分達到滿分10分，影響Extended Passport（EPP），未通過身分驗證的攻擊者可在特定情境下，利用含有惡意EPP標頭的特製請求觸發漏洞，有可能引起未定義的行為，或是造成程式異常終止。

items.summary: fix(doctor): preserve source state during full lint (#142839) Use the prepared source environment for Doctor state-integrity findings, repair previews, and session-store paths. Keep generated skill links and nested read-only SQLite access inside the existing private snapshot scope while preserving source-profile skill eligibility. The built full-lint CLI retains all 62 checks, reports real source-directory problems, and preserves source database and sidecar bytes. Default and separate-profile skill controls, focused regression tests, exact-head review, and hosted CI pass. Ordinary lint's existing shared-memory mutation remains a separate follow-up. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: docs(gateway): split the tools configuration reference by domain (#14…
items.summary: docs(gateway): split the tools configuration reference by domain (#142960) docs/gateway/config-tools.md was 59,564 characters across two H2 topics that mixed reference keys, a long explanation of the managed GitHub identity, and how-to provider recipes. Split by reader job into docs/gateway/config-tools/, keeping the parent as a short index. Children: - tool-policy — tool profiles, tool groups, the sandbox tool gate, tools.codeMode, and the allow/deny, byProvider, toolsBySender, and elevated layers (14,547 chars) - github-identity — tools.github: the shared managed gh identity, token refresh, and the execution boundaries that receive it (10,641 chars) - built-in-tools — tools.exec, tools.loopDetection, tools.web, tools.media, tools.updatePlan (6,254 chars) - sessions-and-subagents — tools.agentToAgent, tools.sessions, tools.sessions_spawn, agents.defaults.subagents (7,033 chars) - custom-providers — models.providers registration, base-URL trust, and the provider field reference (12,309 chars) - provider-examples — worked configurations for nine providers (8,980 chars) Anchor strategy: per-anchor routes are impossible here because redirectSource() rejects any source containing [?#], so every id the page published stays alive on the parent index as an authored stub next to a link to its new home. parseDocsDocument reports 58 ids before the split; 57 are stubbed and `related` is still published by the index itself, so no duplicate authored/canonical ID is raised. Backticked headings emit both a dotted and a dashed id (tools.github and tools-github) and both are preserved, as is the percent-encoded tools.allow-%2F-tools.deny, the pre-existing authored toolsupdateplan stub, and the ten Accordion-minted ids. All 58 resolve through resolveDocsFragment against the new index, and all 40 index-to-child fragment links resolve on their destination child. Losslessness (source body vs. the six children, measured mechanically against the base sha, not against a working copy): 54 fence markers before and after with identical info strings; 47 table rows before and after; all 12 original outbound links still present; each child's body byte-identical to its source line range after H3-to-H2 promotion. Two thematic breaks that separated the former H2 sections are dropped because those sections are now separate pages, and the empty container heading "## Tools" is not reproduced — its anchor is stubbed. One prose change, the declared orphaned-cross-reference exception: "See the llama.cpp example below" in the compat table pointed at a section that now lives on another page, so it became a real link. The other six directional references stayed within a single child and were re-verified there. taxonomy.yaml references this page without a fragment, so validateTaxonomyDocsReferences still resolves it; maturity:check passes. The eight qa/scenarios docsRefs and the two src/ docs URLs also target the surviving route. Closes audit findings: r3-0337, r3-1539
